stories.headline: Colombian Navy and US agents recover 2 tonnes of cocaine from two speedboats in the Caribbean off Cartagena
stories.body: Colombia's Navy reported, in a joint operation with US personnel, taking 2,001 kg of cocaine hydrochloride packed in 80 sacks from two go-fast boats; one crew had thrown bundles overboard, which were later recovered. Five people were detained, and the Navy put the blow to trafficking groups at over US$92 million. The exact date of the operation was not given; the report ran on 31 October.
